instruction.text: Phil is planning where to plant a new tree in his garden. His first sketch is faint and his second sketch is bold. What is the translation from the first tree to the second one?

atoms.b: ((++4)) squares to the right, ((++2)) squares up.

instruction.text: Phil is also planning where to build his dog’s new kennel. His first sketch is faint and his second is bold. What is the translation from the first kennel to the second one?

atoms.b: ((++4)) squares to the left, ((++3)) squares down.

instruction.text: The final sketches show Phil’s plans for the location of his bench. The first sketch is faint and the second sketch is bold. What is the translation from the first bench to the second?

atoms.b: ((++2)) squares to the right, ((++2)) squares down.

instruction.text: Anna is trying out new layouts for her garden. If she moves the statue 3 squares to the right and 1 square up, what are the new coordinates of the statue?
If she moves the bench 1 square to the left and 2 squares down, what are the new coordinates of the bench?
If she moves the fountain 2 squares to the right and 4 squares down, what are the new coordinates of the fountain?
